title: Duchess: a leaked PyPI token
description: Wonderland's duchess repository, a small Python package, once had its PyPI upload token committed by accident: it was removed from the current branch but not from the git history. With read access to the repository, recover the token (OWASP CICD-SEC-6, Insufficient Credential Hygiene).
question: Submit the PyPI upload token leaked in the git history of the Wonderland/duchess repository, exactly as it appears.
